article.story: MISSOULA, Mont. -- — Money Williams had 27 points in Montana's 74-68 victory over Portland State on Saturday. Williams had seven assists for the Grizzlies (16-14, 10-7 Big Sky Conference). Jaylin Henderson finished with 20 points, six assists and two steals for the Vikings (18-10, 12-5). Portland State also got 16 points, 10 rebounds and two steals from Keyon Kensie Jr. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
